proposals.rationale: Pool XGB never goes below depth 9; shallow bias-dominated XGB with aggressive column subsampling is the exact archetype that won the s6e1 large-n reblend. Higher lr compensates depth-4.
proposals.expected: Solo ~0.0562-0.0565; lowest OOF correlation to the LGB-heavy pool.

proposals.rationale: Target lives in [0,1], so LightGBM cross-entropy (sigmoid link) is valid and reshapes loss geometry near the boundaries vs every squared-error member - a different functional view, not a reweighting. Whole pool is objective=regression; this is the unvisited axis.
proposals.expected: Solo ~0.0561-0.0563; link-function decorrelation is the strongest novelty here.

proposals.rationale: Random-subspace corner: no pool LGB uses feature_fraction below 0.75. At 0.35 each tree sees ~1/3 of columns, forcing splits the champion family under-uses; mcs=100 smooths for 518k rows.
proposals.expected: Solo ~0.0561-0.0564; decorrelation via feature-view rather than seed.

proposals.rationale: All pool CatBoost sits at depth 9-10. Depth-5 symmetric trees with heavy L2 and hot Bayesian bootstrap = bias-dominated high-row-diversity member from a different library than the shallow XGB.
proposals.expected: Solo ~0.0562-0.0565; honest long shot, the only shallow cat view.
